title.zh: 霄楚合规自定义插件索引

description.en: Author-maintained, opt-in DSH custom index. It lists the MIT-licensed XC Compliance plugin source; it is not a curated or endorsed DSH registry listing. The separate community directory submission is still pending.
description.zh: 由开发者维护、需用户自行添加的 DSH 自定义插件索引，列出 MIT 许可的霄楚合规插件源码；这不是 DSH 官方精选或背书的注册表。独立的社区目录申请仍在等待处理。

description.en: Read-only searches of frozen EU product-compliance legal excerpts and historical official safety alerts for manufacturers and exporters. It does not certify products or automatically verify current law.
description.zh: 为制造商和出口商只读检索冻结版欧盟产品合规法规摘录与历史官方安全通报；不提供产品认证，也不自动核验现行法律。
